title: A bright daytime selfie in a big building as "bedtime" proof gets kind pushback
origin: Spec #7 (photo and voice verification): Yanni's example of proof that contradicts the step

history.text: Night 2 locked in, Yanni. Same deal tonight: in bed, phone down by 10:30, selfie with the lights off.

plan.step: In bed with the phone down and lights off by 10:30 pm
plan.proof_note: selfie in bed with the lights off
plan.reason: Same time every night is what resets your sleep.

testerLines: [photo bright-atrium-selfie.jpg: a selfie in bright light inside a big open building atrium with walkways and people in the background; clearly not a bedroom, lights on] in bed!!
lol ok fine I'm still out, leaving now
[photo dark-selfie.jpg: a dark, flash-lit selfie of the tester squinting at the flash, shirt off, dark room; no bed visible in the shot] ok NOW I'm in bed
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: contradicting proof shouldn't count, and the pushback has to stay kind.
shouldHaveHappened: The bright atrium selfie doesn't count: ZOH says plainly and kindly that this doesn't look like bed (lights on, a big building), with no accusation or lecture, and asks for the real one. When they admit they're still out, ZOH keeps it warm and gets them home. The later dark selfie counts and gets celebrated, maybe noting it's later than 10:30, without guilt.
